# Beck Kanno

> Beck Kanno is a Product Designer and Lead Product Designer at Bridge, a standalone Breeze company. He turns complex products into clear, scalable experiences through strategy, systems, and craft.

## Primary pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://www.bekanno.com/): Beck Kanno's portfolio, selected work, profile, and contact information.
- [Changelog](https://www.bekanno.com/changelog): Public record of recent portfolio updates and content changes.

## Selected work

- [Puplar](https://www.bekanno.com/#project-puplar-dashboard): Multi-rail finance dashboard for payments, accounts, virtual cards, and finance operations.
- [Puplar Mobile](https://www.bekanno.com/#project-puplar-mobile): Mobile banking and wallet experience for crypto funding, virtual dollar cards, and transaction management.
- [Ledger](https://www.bekanno.com/#project-ledger): AI observability dashboard for understanding AI usage, cost, and value.
- [Dash](https://www.bekanno.com/#project-dash): Mobile-first mobility platform combining ride sharing, car rentals, and organisation-based commute services.
- [sunDial](https://www.bekanno.com/#project-sundial): Desktop tool for compressing and transcribing long recordings without requiring FFmpeg commands.
